system.description:
Rogues are the back-alley urchins, gutterborn scum, and shadowed assassins. To hammers, every problem looks like a nail. Rogues are

blades, and every problem is a throat.


Iconic Rogues

• Locke Lamora, Gentleman Bastard Sequence

• Nona Grey, Book of the Ancestor

• Vin, Mistborn

• Zidane Tribal, Final Fantasy IX


Playing Rogue

Rogues are low-defense, midline harassers that focus on one single, deadly shot. They are given Features that reinforce attempting to gain Favor on their Attacks.


Action: Attack

Move: Midline

Starting Pack: Assassin, Conman, Investigator, or Scout


Training: Ranged, Finesse, Sneak

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.description: Your Favored attacks with Finesse, Keen, or Ranged Weapons deal an extra d4 damage and ignore an amount of Armor equal to this number of extra dice. The number of extra d4s increases by 1 every 3 Levels hereafter.

features.name: Infiltrator
features.description: You gain the Resourceful Perk (p. 71), and you have Favor on Checks and Saves made to ambush and against traps that you are aware of.

features.name: Evasive
features.description: Once per Round after another Being uses an Action or Move, you can Move 10’ without using Speed and can continue moving using your remaining Speed.

features.name: Unflinching Luck
features.description: When you spend Luck to Favor a Check, roll a d20. If the result is lower than your remaining Luck, the Luck is not spent. When you become an 8th Level Rogue, the d20 is a d12.

features.name: Waylay
features.description: Once per Round, if you kill an Enemy, you can immediately take one Action.

features.name: Unflinching Luck
features.description: When you spend Luck to Favor a Check, roll a d12. If the result is lower than your remaining Luck, the Luck is not spent.

features.name: Lethal Weapon
features.description: Your Sneak Attack damage dice can Explode.
